a.text: Push Square: “expect to set aside up to 300 hours or more” for the platinum.

b.text: PowerPyx: “about 200 hours” (60–80 story + ~100 checklist + ~10 cleanup); KeenGamer and GTABase agree on 200.

disputes.call: Plan on 200 hours. Three guides converge on 200; Push Square’s 300+ is the outlier and reads like a cautious upper bound, not a measured estimate.
disputes.claim: How long does the platinum take?

a.text: PowerPyx: the balcony meditation “isn’t marked as a ‘Meditation Spot’ like the rest, so is currently unclear if it’s required for the trophy or not.”

b.text: KeenGamer: “Complete the balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1. This is the only currently identified potentially missable trophy-related interaction.”

disputes.call: Do it. It costs two minutes in Chapter 1 and removes the only known missable risk; the uncertainty cuts one way only.
disputes.claim: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation required for Positive Mental Attitude?

a.text: PowerPyx lists the final mission under Chapter 4 (“Starting From Zero”) and also lists a Chapter 5 mission (Operation Savage Glory).

b.text: Beebom and CULTR word the finale as Chapter 5 (reported by CryptoGames).

disputes.call: The story has five chapters; the finale sits on the Chapter 4 → Chapter 5 boundary. Follow the mission name (“Starting From Zero” / the final mission), not the chapter number.
disputes.claim: Which chapter holds the final mission?

a.text: TechWiser (via CryptoGames): “the Stranger mission chains behind five hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress.”

b.text: PowerPyx: “Open world Strangers & Freaks are still there after the story. You don’t have to worry about these.”

disputes.call: Start every stranger chain the moment it unlocks. The warning is single-sourced, but following it costs nothing and the downside of missing a chain is a second playthrough.
disputes.claim: Do Strangers & Freaks chains expire with story progress?

a.text: PowerPyx: “This trophy is currently unknown.”

b.text: KeenGamer: “Enjoy a cocktail overlooking Ocean Beach. Exact trigger still being confirmed.”

disputes.call: Unconfirmed. Try ordering a cocktail at an Ocean Beach bar with a view; no guide has a verified trigger yet, so treat any single method as a guess.
disputes.claim: How does In The Beginning… unlock?

a.text: PowerPyx: “This trophy is currently unknown.”

b.text: GTABase (via CryptoGames): crashing a car out through a showroom window.

disputes.call: Unconfirmed single-source guess. Try smashing a car out of a vehicle showroom; if it does not pop, wait for a verified method rather than grinding showrooms.
disputes.claim: How does Capital Offense unlock?

a.text: PowerPyx: “currently unknown (believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from Prologue).”

b.text: KeenGamer: “Hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method.”

disputes.call: Unconfirmed. The Prologue / Payday Loans link is a guess from the description (“Second time’s the charm”), not a verified trigger.
disputes.claim: How does Bad Luck, I Guess unlock?

a.text: PowerPyx: “currently unknown (believed to be from UFO questline).”

b.text: GTABase (via CryptoGames): “a strange event somewhere in Leonida.”

disputes.call: Unconfirmed. The UFO questline is the leading guess and matches the description (“What the hell just happened?”); keep an eye on stranger activity outside Vice City.
disputes.claim: How does The Truth Is Out There unlock?

a.text: PowerPyx: “currently unknown (believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle).”

b.text: KeenGamer: “Perform the required melee drive-by elimination. Precise method still being confirmed.”

disputes.call: Both versions point at the same act: a melee hit from a moving bike. Try a drive-by melee kick from a motorcycle; the exact enemy and speed are unconfirmed.
disputes.claim: How does Ten Pin unlock?

a.text: PowerPyx: “It’s still undergoing confirmation which animal exactly unlocks this.”

b.text: KeenGamer: “Hunt a unique animal for Bret.”

disputes.call: Finish Bret’s Target Decks (15 of 15 for 100%). The trophy will come from one of those hunts; no guide names the animal yet.
disputes.claim: Which animal does Fair Game want?

a.text: PowerPyx: steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn, a Gang Operation.

b.text: KeenGamer: “Steal the three key valuables at Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley and escape.”

disputes.call: Same place, two names: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is the Kolt & Associates site. Take the luxury watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun and the safe, then lose the police.
disputes.claim: Where is the bowling alley for Let’s Go Bowling?

a.text: Official description only: “A partnership with mass appeal.” No method is stated.

b.text: PowerPyx and GTABase: maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time.

disputes.call: Max Strength for both characters together. Two guides agree on the method; the description is a joke, not a method.
disputes.claim: What does Personal Best actually ask for?

a.text: Push Square: two shooting range locations — Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin Shooting Range (Balsero).

b.text: PowerPyx: “All 12 Shooting Range Locations & 42 Gold Medals.”

disputes.call: Both are right at different levels: 12 challenge sites sit inside the two named ranges. Gold all 42 challenges; the range count is a labelling difference.
disputes.claim: How many shooting ranges are there — 2 or 12?

a.text: PowerPyx: 31 Landmarks + 35 Curiosities + 23 Sculptures = 89 named scans, plus No Flusher Tags (no count given).

b.text: Official description: “WAiNK It at 100 locations.”

disputes.call: Scan everything. The 89 named categories leave 11+ scans to come from No Flusher Tags, whose total no guide states.
disputes.claim: What makes up the 100 WAiNK scans?

a.text: KeenGamer: “Rob three shops consecutively with your partner without clearing your Wanted Level.”

b.text: PowerPyx: “If it doesn’t unlock after the 3rd shop, hit a 4th shop and keep going until it unlocks” — the pop is delayed ~30 seconds.

disputes.call: Plan for four shops. The trophy pops late, so a third shop that “did nothing” may just not have registered yet.
disputes.claim: Does Retail Therapy need 3 shops or 4?

a.text: PowerPyx: “You will actually get this automatically during Chapter 4 – Optional Mission: That’s Where The Money Is…”

b.text: PowerPyx (manual method): drive the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County; cops cannot follow on the tracks.

disputes.call: Both work. The mission route is free — bank vaults give 4 stars by themselves — so only use the tunnel if you want it early.
disputes.claim: Best way to escape a 4-star wanted level with your partner?

a.text: PowerPyx: “automatically unlocked in Chapter 4 – Optional Mission: That’s Where The Money Is… Robbing the vault of a large bank automatically counts as robbing an armored truck.”

b.text: PowerPyx (earlier method): block an armored truck, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up, then escape the heat radius.

disputes.call: The vault route is confirmed and comes free with the 100% robberies; the street-truck route is reported to work earlier if you want it in Chapter 3.
disputes.claim: How do you rob an armored truck?

a.text: KeenGamer: “Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport.”

b.text: PowerPyx: it must be a plane docked to a departure terminal (E3/E4), not one on the airfield; fly 1 km away from the airport.

disputes.call: Use the docked plane at terminals E3/E4 and fly 1 km out. Airfield planes are reported not to count.
disputes.claim: Which plane counts for Catch Me If You Can?

a.text: PowerPyx: “The trophy doesn’t seem to work on soldiers, police, and civilians.”

b.text: GameMapa: “Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus” — no restriction stated.

disputes.call: Target gang members at Illegal Operations. The restriction is single-sourced, but gang members are confirmed to count, so there is no reason to test the rest.
disputes.claim: Which enemies count for Gunslinger?

a.text: PowerPyx confirms 4 strands: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete — “there are more strangers yet to be discovered.”

b.text: KeenGamer: “Complete eight qualifying Stranger mission strands” — no list of which eight.

disputes.call: The four named strands are confirmed; four more are not yet identified. Track the count in the trophy list and finish every stranger chain you find.
disputes.claim: Which 8 strands count for Strangers & Freaks?
